retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: this is a referendum that never happened. It was planned for 9 October 2005 on ratifying the Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe, and was abandoned after the French and Dutch votes of that summer killed the treaty. The atlas holds events that occurred; a cancelled ballot is a fact about a government's calendar. What could be written instead is the abandonment itself, as part of the Portuguese presidency of 2007 and the treaty that replaced the constitution.

title: Portuguese European Constitution referendum
